text:
Only your heart hot,
and nothing more.


My paraíso a field
without ruiseñor
ni liras,
with a river discreto
and a fuentecilla.


Without the espuela of the wind
over the fronda,
ni the star that quiere
be leaf.


A enorme light
that outside
luciérnaga
of another,
in a field
of gazes rotas.


A reposo claro
and there our besos,
lunares sonoros
of the echo,
itself abrirían very far.


And your heart hot,
nothing more.

translation.title: Desire
